items.text: Do sailing boats move slower in strong winds?
Has this exam finished yet?
Do honest people often tell lies?
Can we shorten a coat by cutting a piece o the bottom?
Should we look both ways before crossing the road?
Do people sometimes judge others by their appearance?
Will you be answering these questions until 10am tomorrow morning?
Is a guest a person who invites someone to their house?
If we double the number 50, do we get 100?
Are the duties of a policeman to help people and catch criminals?
Is sunset at the beginning of the day?
Supposing today were Sunday, would tomorrow be Monday?
Is the following sentence correct: “He speaks English, speaks he”?
Do newspapers have the legal right to print stories that aren't true?
Do most women have their hair cut at the hairdresser's?
Is the elbow one of the joints of the arm?
Is this sentence right: “Tell to them the same story that you told to me”?
Is “noon” another word for “midday”?
Has this exam already started?
Would you say that an area full of mountains was flat?
The arrow
flew through the air
and hit the tree
in the middle.
He looked very strange;
he had fair hair
but a dark beard.
I do not know
how much they gave him,
but it was a large amount.
She goes to the same café
every morning for a snack.
Poor John was not invited
to Mary's birthday party.
I am sorry,
but I have already thrown
the old cooker away;
it was too dangerous to keep.
